steps.prompt: Walk up to the court: move with {move}.
Move with {move}. Hold {dodge} while moving to sprint.
Dribble strike: walk up to a crew member and press {light}.
Crossover: while holding the ball, move and tap {dodge}.
Ankle-breaker: with the ball, tap {dodge} right as a defender winds up. Watch for the red glow over their head.
Shoot at the crate hoop: hold {shoot}, release at the top of the meter.
Defense: they've got the ball now. When the ball handler glows red, press {hands_up} to strip it.
Heal: press {quarter_water} to drink a Quarter Water.

crew_laugh: Look at this one. Can't even see over the ball.
crew_beaten: Aight, aight. You can hoop a little.
...Yo. Why'd the lights just go out?
wake_cat: (Something warm and heavy is sitting on your chest. It's a cat.)
(The cat blinks at you, slowly. Then goes back to sleep.)
wake_pops: Pops: Easy, easy. You took a hit from somebody who doesn't miss.
Pops: Look at the clock. Three AM. Every clock in this city stopped at three, and the sun ain't coming up.
Pops: The one who ended you? They call him Midnight. He runs the Garden, over in the City. Nobody crosses the bridges without five Crowns.
Pops: One Crown per borough. Here in {borough}, three courts decide who wears it.
Pops: Beat all three and the {borough} Crown is yours. Start with {first}. Follow the marker when you're outside.
Pops: Pet the cat when you need a rest: it heals you and saves, but the crews come back. Spend your Rep at the counter to level up.
Pops: Now go. If you lose the thread, come talk to me.
pops_talk: Pops: {detail}. Follow the marker when you're outside.
Pops: Rest with the cat, level up at the counter. Then go get it.
